page.overview:
What is magizoologist?

A Magizoologist was a wizard or witch who studied magical creatures professionally (a field known as magizoology); though they might also be referred to as wizarding naturalists.

In certain cases, a Magizoologist's obligations might not be limited to merely observing and taking care of magical creatures, as they might even be immersed in sanctioned breeding, and even actively tracking and rescuing them from less-principled parties.

A wizard or witch might not need to have graduated from a wizarding school to become a Magizoologist, as Newt Scamander was expelled from Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, and still managed to become a highly renowned Magizoologist in his adult life. Rubeus Hagrid also did not graduate from Hogwarts, but later became the Care of Magical Creatures Professor.

The Scamander family had many members that have worked as magizoologists. One of the most famous magizoologists was Newt Scamander. He was the author of . Early in life, Scamander developed an interest in magical creatures that was influenced by his mother's breeding of Hippogriffs. Newt's grandson Rolf and his wife Luna were considered wizarding naturalists.
